title: LegacyImportService
responsibility: Imports this repository's legacy reports into the evidence branch as recorded.

inputs.name: LegacyImportService.constructor.root
inputs.description: The path of this repository's working tree that the service is built for. It is passed to the git adapter, the evidence-branch and history-note repositories and the LFS adapter, and when no project is given, a run belongs here only if its recorded project path resolves to the same directory as this path or as another worktree of the repository.

inputs.name: LegacyImportService.import.store
inputs.description: The path of the old report store that the import reads. The store is opened as a LegacyReportRepository and only read, so every run it lists ends up either in imported or in skipped.

inputs.name: LegacyImportService.import.project
inputs.description: An optional project name or id that must equal the id or the name recorded on a run's project, compared exactly. When it is omitted (undefined) or an empty string, a run belongs here only if its recorded project path resolves to one of the repository's working trees; a given value skips that check, so it can also match runs recorded in other working trees.

outputs.name: LegacyImportService.import
outputs.description: The resolved LegacyImport of one call: imported lists the runs this call stored, ordered by startedAt and then id, and skipped lists the runs it left out with a reason. Each run in the old store appears in exactly one of the two lists.
